scientific_question: In an expert-curated non-BindingDB source, do frozen affinity models retain a source-wide pKd association while losing materially more performance for within-target ligand ranking?
source_snapshot_rule: Use the official fixed 2026.2 PostgreSQL release when technically accessible; otherwise use one date-stamped API acquisition while the official site reports release 2026.2. Hash every raw response.

row_inclusion.numeric_policy: finite exact numerical value; no open inequality, range-only, or missing value
row_inclusion.ligand_policy: RDKit-parseable covalent small-molecule structure; exclude peptides, antibodies, proteins, inorganic ligands, mixtures, and structureless records
row_inclusion.target_policy: single-protein target with one unambiguous amino-acid sequence; exclude complexes, families, fused multi-target records, antibodies as targets, and unresolved species/sequence
row_inclusion.replicate_policy: retain a single source interaction record as the sampling row; for duplicate exact pair/reference records use the median pKd after unblinding and keep a duplicate-count field
row_inclusion.qualifier_policy: exclude censored or non-exact outcomes from quantitative primary analysis; retain them only for a prespecified active/inactive sensitivity analysis when the source qualifier is machine-resolvable

blind_feasibility_gates.action_if_any_gate_fails: STOP_WITH_NO_CONFIRMATORY_GTOPDB_COHORT; report the failed gate without opening model-performance results

firewalls.pair_key: sha256(RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES + '|' + uppercase ungapped protein sequence)
firewalls.document_rule: Exclude a candidate record if any stable PMID or DOI maps to a previously exposed source document. Exclude unresolved-reference records from confirmatory analysis.
firewalls.development_overlap_rule: Exact development-pair overlap is always excluded even if the source reference differs.

primary_estimands.source_wide: Spearman correlation between frozen predicted pKd and observed pKd across all eligible rows
primary_estimands.within_target: Spearman correlation after ranking observed and predicted pKd separately within each eligible target, pooled across rows with target-equal weights
primary_estimands.attenuation: source-wide Spearman minus pooled target-equal within-target Spearman
primary_estimands.target_distribution: median and interquartile range of target-specific Spearman correlations

secondary_estimands: source-wide and within-target metrics stratified by ligand novelty and target novelty

inference.resampling_unit: two-stage target then source-reference cluster bootstrap, preserving all rows in a selected reference cluster
inference.null_tests: within-target permutation of predictions, 10000 permutations, fixed random seed 20260802
inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg within each estimand family; panel-level decision uses fixed model counts and unadjusted model-level 95% intervals
inference.missing_prediction_policy: model-specific complete cases with coverage reported; a model requires at least 80% cohort coverage to count toward a panel decision

decision_branches.replicated_scale_ranking_split: At least 3 of 4 nonreference models have source-wide rho 95% CI entirely above 0 and attenuation 95% CI entirely above 0; at least 3 of 4 have median target-specific rho lower than source-wide rho; no single target or reference reverses the panel conclusion.
decision_branches.global_only_no_material_attenuation: At least 3 of 4 nonreference models have source-wide rho 95% CI entirely above 0, but fewer than 3 meet the attenuation rule.
decision_branches.within_target_transport_present: At least 3 of 4 nonreference models have target-equal within-target rho 95% CI entirely above 0 and attenuation is not positive by the panel rule.
decision_branches.heterogeneous_or_inconclusive: No other branch applies, support is insufficient, or influence diagnostics show source concentration.
decision_branches.negative_generalization: At least 3 of 4 nonreference models have source-wide rho 95% CI including or below 0 and target-equal within-target rho 95% CI including or below 0.

interpretation_limits: GtoPdb is independent curation, not automatically an independent underlying experiment; only the reference-disjoint subset supports the strongest claim.
This is a retrospective outcome-unexposed replication, not a historically prospective submission by the model authors.
A failed or inconclusive branch is retained and reported; no source or endpoint replacement is allowed after unblinding.
This analysis does not alter the already completed v1.12 BindingDB result.
